name: Shelly
description: Imports Shelly devices from the local network into the knowledge graph: devices with a switch and power metering become smart plugs, all others devices (manufacturer, model, MAC, IP address, firmware, generation, host name). AI clients get live power, energy, voltage, temperature, Wi-Fi signal and available firmware updates. Read-only: the plugin only reads and never switches. Works with Gen1 (/shelly, /status) and Gen2 and later (RPC over HTTP, /rpc/Shelly.GetStatus); MQTT and the Shelly Cloud are not used. Settings: url (the first device, e.g. http://192.168.1.50), device2_url to device10_url (further devices, one address each: a plugin may only reach the hosts entered in its own address settings, so up to 10 devices per project; for more devices use the Home Assistant plugin), optional password (device password, sent only when a device asks for it: digest login as admin for Gen2 and later, basic login for Gen1; the same password for all devices) and optional username (Gen1 only, default admin). Shelly devices only speak plain HTTP on the local network, so use them on a trusted network or VLAN.

mcpTools.name: shelly.sync
mcpTools.description: Import the configured Shelly devices into the knowledge graph now.

mcpTools.name: shelly.status
mcpTools.description: Live status of every configured Shelly: per output on/off, power (W), energy (kWh), voltage and temperature; Wi-Fi network and signal (dBm), IP address, uptime and available firmware update.
